financebench_open150_dev.purpose: Development slice of the FinanceBench open-source 150 set for local regression and harness tuning.

financebench_open150_test.purpose: Held-out slice of the FinanceBench open-source 150 set for external QA evaluation.

financebench_open150_all.purpose: Full FinanceBench open-source 150 benchmark run across all supported single-company QA items.

financebench_pepsico_11.purpose: Single-company smoke run on the largest FinanceBench company subset (PepsiCo, 11 items).

financebench_amd_8.purpose: Single-company smoke run on a compact tech-company subset (AMD, 8 items).
